aboutGame.title: What is Paint and Seek?
paragraphs: Paint and Seek is a Roblox camouflage hide-and-seek game where hiders paint their avatars into walls, props, and color families while seekers clear the map by reading movement, silhouette mistakes, and bad positioning.

Each role rewards a different playstyle. Hiders study surfaces and escape routes, while Seekers clear rooms systematically, identify unnatural shapes, and revisit high-probability hiding zones before the timer expires.
